name: ISO 21920-1 surface texture indication
source: ISO 21920-1:2021 Geometrical product specifications (GPS) - Surface texture: Profile - Part 1: Indication of surface texture (replaces ISO 1302:2002). Legacy proportions and the Ra series from ISO 1302:1978.
verifiedFrom: https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S01/is.10719.1983.pdf (IS 10719:1983, identical with ISO 1302:1978: clauses 3 and 4, Table 1, Annex B)

forms.addition: a line closing the two legs into a triangle
a circle inscribed between the two legs

symbol.basicShape: Two legs of unequal length, inclined at about 60 degrees to the line of the surface, the longer leg continuing in a horizontal line on top (ISO 1302:1978, 3.1 describes the legs; ISO 21920-1:2021 Figure 4 shows the shapes).
symbol.barAbove: ISO 21920-1 symbols carry a short horizontal bar above the short leg, which distinguishes them from the ISO 1302 symbols and from areal surface texture symbols (ISO 21920-1:2021, 6.2, NOTE 2).
symbol.proportionsNote: ISO 21920-1:2021 gives the proportions in Annex A (normative), which was not in the preview. Until it is seen, MechPilot draws the symbol with legacyProportions below and marks it as such.

legacyProportions.source: ISO 1302:1978, Annex B, B.1.1 and B.3 (withdrawn edition)
legacyProportions.lineWidthNote: Symbol line thickness d' = h/10, h = height of the dimension lettering on the drawing (B.1.1).
legacyProportions.meaning: H1 = height of the short leg, H2 = height of the long leg (ISO 1302:1978, Figures 27 to 30)

indication.minimal: Graphical symbol, then the parameter symbol and its tolerance limit value, separated by a single blank, e.g. Ra 1,6 written under the horizontal line of the long leg (ISO 21920-1:2021, 6.1, 6.3.2 and Figure 5).
indication.parametersWithDefaultsSource: ISO 21920-1:2021, 6.3.2, NOTE 1 (defaults in ISO 21920-3:2021, Tables 3 to 6)
indication.orientation: Symbol and text oriented to be read from the bottom or the right-hand side of the drawing; the symbol points to the surface from outside the material (ISO 1302:1978, 5.1; to confirm for ISO 21920-1 clause 9).

raSeriesSource: ISO 1302:1978, 4.1.5, Table 1: Ra values with roughness grade numbers N1 (0,025) to N12 (50). Kept as the list of values MechPilot offers first; any value may be typed.
notes: Ra values are micrometres by convention of the standard; raSeriesUnit says so explicitly. Every length on the symbol is in mm.
Whether the N grade numbers survive in ISO 1302:2002 or ISO 21920 was not checked; MechPilot does not write N numbers on drawings.

Complete indications (tolerance type, acceptance rule 16 % / max, filter types and nesting indices, evaluation length, manufacturing process, lay) follow ISO 21920-1:2021, 6.4 and Figures 7 to 9; MechPilot's first version writes only the minimal indication plus an optional process text.
